My top best selling products on Etsy✨🩷 After 6 years of selling print on demand products through Printify + Etsy, these are some of the products that have consistently been best sellers for me: • Sweatshirts My favorites are the Gildan 18000 + Comfort Colors 1566. They’re super versatile, come in tons of colors, and there are now even more ways to customize them with DTG, DTF, embroidery AND some new printing options from Printify. Glitter puff print?!! More on that soon👀👀 • Phone Cases One of my favorite evergreen products because people are constantly switching out their cases. They’re also SO easy to design with patterns, photos, personalized designs and more. Plus, they’re especially great around new phone releases! • Glass Tumbler Cups These have been a bestseller for me ever since Printify released them! The prints come out so crisp and vibrant, they include a lid + straw, and they’re perfect for personalized gifts. And yes, even though they’re glass, I’ve sold a ton and have rarely had shipping issues! • Hardcover Journals Simple, easy to customize and such a good gift product. Patterns and personalized designs work especially well, and the print quality is SO good. I own way too many myself! • Embroidered Hats Especially the vintage + denim hats! I love the color options, the embroidery comes out super clean, and these have consistently sold really well in my shop. • Mugs A classic for a reason, but I like choosing mugs that stand out a little more while someone is scrolling. The accent color mugs + latte mugs are two of my favorites! The best part? These are all evergreen products, meaning they can sell year round, not just during one specific season! That makes them great products to test whether you’re brand new to Etsy or already growing your shop✨✨ Printify and Etsy are linked in my bio for free!! :)  #printondemand #sidehustleideas #onlinebusinessforbeginners

videos.caption: 🤭How to make money online selling products on Etsy you didn't make yourself using the done for you designs & print on demand method!  👇🏼Read for a step by step!  🙌🏼 How Print On Demand Works:  1. Do Some Quick Product Research - Look for popular items people are buying, like wall art, t-shirts, sweatshirts, phone cases, candles, mugs, or tote bags.   - Use tools like erank, Google Trends or browse online shops to see what's trending. I also look for inspo on Pinterest all the time! I like to use Everbee to see how much money a product is making on Etsy.  2. Create Your Design  - Get done for you designs on ctrl-alt-design.com  - Or create your own. Make your design fun, eye-catching, or niche-specific. Keep it simple and high-quality!   3. Sign Up on Printify  - Create a free account & make sure you connect your account to a store. Examples being Etsy or Shopify. You are walked through how to do this when you sign up, don’t worry it’s easy and fast.  4. Choose a Product on Printify   - Browse the product catalog for posters, t-shirts, hoodies, candles, hats, mugs, phone cases & etc.   - Select the product you want to sell.   5. Upload Your Design   - Click on the product to customize it.   - Upload your design.   - Position and resize it to fit the product nicely.   6. Fill Out Listing Details  - Write a catchy product title and description with keywords.   - Set your price (consider costs and your profit margin).   7. Publish Your Product  - Remember to connect your online store (Shopify, Etsy, etc.) with Printful . This makes it so whenever you make a sale, Printify knows instantly so it can print the design on the product for you and send it to the customer for you!  - Publish your product so it’s live and ready for customers.   8. Market Your Product - Share your product on social media, use Pinterest, create ads, or tell friends. Make videos of your product or make Pinterest pins.  - Focus on your target audience to attract more buyers. Not a must but it can help!  #howtomakemoneyonline #sidehustle #onlinesidehustle #printondemand #digitalproducts

Etsy sellers, before you panic about the new AI image rules… READ THIS. 👇 Etsy is NOT banning AI-generated images or mockups across the board. But there are some important distinctions sellers need to understand. Here's what you need to know: ✨ AI-generated digital products are still permitted when they meet Etsy's Creativity Standards, including disclosure requirements. ✨ Print-on-demand sellers can still use qualifying mockups, but your images need to accurately represent the product your customer will receive. ✨ Handmade and physical product sellers have stricter photo requirements. Not every AI-generated lifestyle image is acceptable as a replacement for real product photography. #etsysellersoftiktok #etsysmallbusiness #printondemand #fyppp #etsymockups
